name: systemd Service Management
description: Read unit status, the journal, and the unit file before a restart, and confirm the service is active afterward.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read systemctl status and the journal on a configured server alias.
Run the same systemctl checks when the unit is local.
Read a unit file in the project before editing it.

validation.rule: systemctl status and the journal were read before a restart, daemon-reload ran only after a unit file change, and the service was active on the follow-up status.
